title: The Badge in the Ditch
lines: Ben lost his little badge in a ditch.
It fell off his black vest.
Ben and Meg dig in the wet mud.
Meg finds a stick and a big rock.
Then Ben spots it next to the hedge.
The badge is stuck in thick mud.
Ben tugs and tugs at it.
He grabs it and rubs the mud off.
Meg pins the badge back on his vest.

questions.ask: Where did Ben lose his badge?
questions.listenFor: In a ditch. It fell off his black vest. If they say 'in the mud' that is close, and the ditch line will show them the rest.

questions.ask: Who spotted the badge first, Ben or Meg?
questions.listenFor: Ben spotted it by the hedge. Meg found a stick and a rock first, which is a nice trap for a fast guesser.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben was a good friend to Meg? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for the reason, like the hug at the end, or that Meg helped him dig.
